title: Interconnect co-process law

claims.text: Cortex uses one SQLite substrate for inventory, graph, neural, sessions, cards, and organism pulses.
During a session the agent is temporary working cortex; Cortex is durable body; host and human retain authority.
Always read control_error and governor mode before acting; read_only forbids host mutation.
Session life is systole activate, diastole remember, breathe rebind, sealed consolidate.
ARIA is known and deferred; active only on typed cues; never auto-executed or mutation-granting.

claim_boundary: Memory packet is teaching mass for retrieval; never host authority.
